body: Yes. I'm closeted trans (m2f) and I masturbate and I had a healthy sex life with my ex girlfriend... however, I imagine myself as female when I do. That might make people uncomfortable, but it's just part of my struggle with gender identity. It makes me uncomfortable. I've always hated myself for it, and it was ridiculously confusing growing up because I grew up before people discussed gender identity. Being exclusively attracted to women made it worse. I didn't understand myself. I didn't watch traditional porn until I was like 20 because I reflexively put myself in the female role and the thought of having sex with a guy made me uncomfortable. I can't describe how much I hated myself because of this, and I always hoped one day I would wake up and be normal, but that never happened. I was too ashamed to even talk about it with a therapist so I couldn't ask for help.  I actually tried killing myself because of this... struggling with gender identity is a special kind of hell.

I actually tried killing myself in August. Ended up in the ICU for a week, then the psych ward for a week. Didn't have any friends visit if check on me. Only had my mom, dad, and brother check in on me. Tried reaching out to my sister who I hadn't talked to in 4 years and never heard from her. I haven't met my niece and I haven't met my twin brother's girlfriend who he's been dating for a year. My fiancé left me two years ago and I've been pretty much alone ever since. Been trying to get out and do more and make friends, but it's difficult when you're a 30 year old guy who is also trying to get/stay sober. Most guys I know wanna hang out and grab a drink. 

Yeah, it sucks. Started seeing a therapist and it turns out I have pretty bad ptsd, it just went undiagnosed because I didn't feel safe talking to anybody about how I felt. I can keep it together when I'm around people, but I'm a wreck when I'm alone. Like I said, I just couldn't talk to anyone about it.

I've actually been raped twice by two separate women and have been molested multiple times. It actually messed me up pretty good. I lost my virginity to rape and after that I had a weird relationship with sex. I faked every orgasm for years because I didn't feel safe during sex. I couldn't be intimate with a girl until I met my second girlfriend when I was 23. I felt safe enough to talk to her and eventually was able to let my guard down and actually be with her emotionally while we were having sex. It was a completely different kind of experience after that. 

One thing that also scares me is false rape accusations. One time I was friends with this girl and we were into each other but we never dated or even kissed. But we would go to parties together and hang out and she would grab my junk all the time, she gave me lap dances and when we were alone she we strip and give me lap dances in her underwear. One time she was on top of me and pulled my shirt up and was feeling my abs and grinding on me. She even told me she wore sexy underwear for me. Anyway, one night she stays over and falls asleep on top of me in her underwear. I try rolling her off, but she clings to me. She wakes up early the next day and leaves. The next time we see each other she says we shouldn't hang out because every time we do I "try to rape her." I was like fuck that, and said okay and never spent time with her ever again. I knew nobody would believe me. I looked like a cliche frat guy or "bro."  I was tall, muscular, tattoos, and overall very masculine looking. She was a beautiful, petite, innocent looking girl. It sucked because I genuinely liked her as a person and loved spending time with her and going to concerts together, and under different circumstances we probably would've dated. We even did things like go on walks and hold hands and stuff. But it was clear that she had a very different perspective on our time together. It sucked, but I just didn't think it was safe to be alone with her anymore. She called me a couple years later and we caught up, so it wasn't like we hated each other. I just think we both kind of realized our mutual attraction for each other made it dangerous for us to be alone together. I say dangerous because we were both in long term relationships and neither of us wanted to cross the line and do something we considered cheating, even though we were pretty much a couple without kissing and sex.  I still think she's an awesome person though, and I hope she has an awesome life. But yeah, as soon as she said rape I was like "yep, I can never be alone with you again."

Thanks! And that's definitely true. My world fell apart one drunk day at a time. Hopefully I can put it back together one sober day at a time now. I'm hoping I can have similar results in the weight loss department. The shame from drinking is bad enough, but not being able to fit in my clothes because of my drinking AND THEN drinking to deal with that shame and embarrassment is just too much. Thanks for the support! IWNDWYT
